description: Personas for the Cork family road trip to the Hungarian GP 2026 (via Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, Hungary).

personas.name: Daniel Cork
personas.context: Plans the trip on a laptop the night before each leg, and glances at the app at motorway rest stops. Owns the route, the drive-time budget, and the bookings.
goals: Get a clear pre-drive briefing for the day: where we're going, how long, where to break
See at a glance whether a day's driving is within a comfortable limit (drive-health)
Print or save a one-page day route sheet to reference without signal
Scan the itinerary for any campsite that still isn't booked
pain_points: Notes get truncated in the sidebar so check-in details are cut off
Switching between the map and the sidebar to piece a day together is fiddly
Booking references are tiny, unselectable text
personas.quote: Before we set off I just want the day on one screen — drive time, where we stop, and the campsite address.

ability_profile.temporary: Tired after a long day's drive; reduced focus
ability_profile.situational: Bright sunlight on the screen at a motorway services; glove-cold hands in winter

personas.name: The Passenger / Navigator
personas.context: Navigates from a phone while Daniel drives. Needs the day's essentials to hand — the next campsite's address for the satnav and its booking confirmation.
goals: Copy the campsite coordinates straight into the satnav in one tap
Read out the booking confirmation number at check-in
Know the plan for today — what we're doing and where we're stopping
Check facilities (electric hook-up, showers, dog-friendly) before arrival
pain_points: On mobile the app currently shows only a map — no stop list, no details at all
No quick way to get an address into the satnav
Confirmation numbers are hard to find in a hurry
personas.quote: Just tell me the next campsite's address and our booking number — I'll do the rest.

ability_profile.situational: Motion sensitivity reading in a moving vehicle; one-handed phone use; patchy mobile signal across borders
